headline: Level eases to SITCON 3; attackers chain Ivanti Connect Secure flaws for root, GitLab and Cisco ASA KEV fixes due today

bullets.text: New: attackers are chaining three Ivanti Connect Secure flaws (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) to gain unauthenticated root access. CISA added Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to KEV on 2026-10-30, due 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-13.
Due today, 2026-11-01, in CISA KEV: the exploited GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229 and the Cisco ASA/FTD flaw CVE-2026-76418, which is being used to crash SSL VPN devices.
A Northflank security breach has led to abuse of customers' AI API keys.
The official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor; WIRED reports it reached thousands of developer devices.
North Korea-linked hackers are blamed for the record $6.3 billion Binance theft, which Binance links to a compromised DevOps laptop; nearly $3 billion has been frozen.
Drupal Commerce Core authorization bypass CVE-2026-118539 remains under active exploitation.

actions: Patch Ivanti Connect Secure now and check appliances for signs of the chained root compromise; the first KEV deadline is 2026-11-02.
Patch GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 today.
If you store AI provider API keys in Northflank, rotate them and review provider usage and billing for abuse.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
Update Drupal Commerce Core for CVE-2026-118539 and check sites for unauthorized access.
Confirm Linux kernel fixes for CVE-2026-46300 are deployed; its KEV due date passed on 2026-10-31.
